jobs.title: Desktop Support Engineer (Dispatch /Part-Time)
jobs.company_description: Axiom Technologies was founded to meet technological needs for medium & large scale enterprises providing end to end IT solutions, globally.
jobs.must_have_skills: Service Desk/Help Desk, Networking, Hardware Support, Customer Service
jobs.description_snippet: **Axiom Technologies** is a Global IT Services partner supporting medium- to large-scale enterprises. Please visit our website for more information about what we do at www.axiomtechnologies.com We are looking for a capable resource to coordinate, ranging from simple activities to more complex plans. This role will provide on-site assistance to end-users within the organisation’s desktop computing environment in a timely and accurate fashion to ensure optimal service delivery. **Role Overview** **We are looking for a reliable and technically skilled Desktop Support Engineer to provide on-demand, on-site** IT support for enterprise clients. This role involves responding to service requests when required and providing hands-on technical assistance for desktop systems, laptops, network connectivity, and peripheral devices at the client location. This is a contract-based, on-demand position, meaning work assignments will be provided as needed. Availability and responsiveness are essential for this role. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide on-site desktop and IT support for end users at the client location. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Windows desktops, laptops, and peripherals. * Install, configure, and maintain hardware, operating systems, and enterprise software applications. * Support network connectivity issues, including LAN troubleshooting. * Assist with device setup, replacement, and hardware installations. * Perform basic network troubleshooting using console access when required. * Document service activities and communicate updates to the service delivery team. * Follow client IT policies and security procedures while performing onsite tasks. **Required Skills** * Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems and desktop environments * Experience in hardware troubleshooting and replacement * Basic understanding of networking (LAN connectivity, switches, routers) * Ability to diagnose and resolve desktop, printer, and peripheral issues * Good communication and customer service skills * Ability to work independently in onsite support environments **Tools Required to Carry** Engineers must carry the following tools while attending onsite support requests: * Windows Laptop * LAN Cable * Console Cable * Screwdriver Toolkit * Basic IT troubleshooting tools Interested candidates are invited to send their resumes to: **careers.in@axiomtechnologies.com**
jobs.blurb: On-site desktop support engineer providing responsive technical assistance to enterprise clients for desktop systems, laptops, and peripherals on a contract basis.

jobs.description_snippet: **Listing reference:** 027144 **Listing status:** Online **Apply by:** 12 October 2026 ##### **Position summary** **Industry:** Wholesale & Retail Trade **Job category:** IT-Quality Assurance and Inspection **Location:** Cape Town **Contract:** Permanent **Remuneration:** Market Related **EE position:** Yes ##### **Introduction** We are looking to recruit a Test Analyst to work within Testing Team in the IT department of Clicks Group Services. The role will be based at Clicks Head Office in Cape Town and will report to the Testing Team Lead. ##### **Job description** We are looking for a detail-oriented and passionate Intermediate Test Analyst to join our Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that business-critical applications and systems meet functional, integration, and quality expectations before release. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to design, execute, and manage testing activities across various projects and platforms. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys problem-solving, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the delivery of high-quality technology solutions **What You'll Be Doing** **Test Analysis & Planning** * Analyse business requirements, user stories, and functional specifications. * Identify testing scope, risks, dependencies, and coverage requirements. * Contribute to test plans, estimates, and testing schedules. * Participate in requirements and solution review sessions. **Test Design & Execution** * Create and maintain test scenarios, test cases, and test data. * Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing. * Validate business processes, interfaces, and data integrity. * Conduct smoke and sanity testing to ensure release readiness. * Record testing evidence and maintain traceability to requirements. **Defect Management** * Identify, log, track, and retest defects. * Collaborate with development teams to support defect resolution. * Participate in defect triage and prioritisation sessions. * Ensure defects are appropriately resolved before deployment. **Quality Assurance & Reporting** * Monitor test progress, coverage, and quality metrics. * Provide regular status updates to project stakeholders. * Highlight risks, issues, and quality concerns proactively. * Support release readiness and test sign-off activities. **Collaboration & Continuous Improvement** * Work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and Business Users. * Participate in Agile ceremonies including stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. * Contribute to improving QA processes, standards, and best practices. * Support automation initiatives and identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency. ##### **Minimum requirements** **Qualifications** * Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
jobs.blurb: Intermediate Test Analyst ensuring business-critical applications meet functional and quality standards before release, working closely with cross-functional teams.

You will be an early adopter of new technology, with your feedback helping to shape ongoing development improvements. **How will yo make a difference?** **Position Responsibilities** * Configure the system as appropriate to operate according to agreed customer requirements * Perform testing / verification of system operation and performance for configured systems * Work with services team to ensure successful deployment of new systems * Work with customers to deliver ongoing configuration changes to the system, ensuring adherence with customer change management requirements * Support firmware, software and configuration updates to ensure the system operates as required * Perform services as defined by Service Level Agreements or as part of project execution, remotely, in the office or on site as required * Own and provide technical support for our customers and partners to ensure customer satisfaction and successful outcomes * Engage with Product Managers to advocate for the customer in terms of quality, functionality and prioritization **What we need to know about you?** We are looking for a dedicated and personable Product Support Engineer to provide technical services and product support to customers using products in the Digital Mine portfolio. This includes CAS (Collision Awareness System) and DGS (Drill Guidance System) as well as other products that are added or developed in the future. **Required Skills** * Experience with Linux administration, Microsoft Server, IIS and SQL Server * Coding exposure to C, C++, Python, Java, HTML or similar * Sound knowledge of current network and communications technology * Ability to read and interpret electrical wiring diagrams * Ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, problem solve and manage resolution to technical system issues * Able to manage and prioritise simultaneous demands in accordance with agreed key performance objectives * Excellent oral and written communication skills, with a high level of attention to detail * Customer service focused, with a strong work ethic and ability to work unsupervised * Good interpersonal and teamwork skills and ability to develop effective customer relationships * Commitment to working safely and ensuring compliance with relevant policies, procedures and legislation **Desirable:** * Tertia

jobs.description_snippet: We’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to help evolve HyperDev’s AI developer platform. jobs.title: Funnel QA Specialist, DTC E-Commerce (Checkout & Tracking)
jobs.description_snippet: About HarZa Group HarZa Group builds and scales direct-to-consumer health and wellness brands. Our flagship brand is Rejuvacare, with RejuvaKnee as our hero product in chronic pain relief, and we are actively launching new brands across the portfolio. We run entirely on paid digital channels, ship primarily into the United States, and have grown twelve times in a single year with close to 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote-first by design and async-first by default. The Role Every funnel we publish carries paid traffic from the moment it goes live. When something breaks here, it does not break quietly in a staging environment. It breaks while we are spending money on it. The expensive failures in this business are rarely the obvious ones. A page that looks perfect but records the order under the wrong offer. An upsell that charges correctly and then sends the customer to a blank screen. A purchase event that fires twice and quietly corrupts the numbers the media buyer is optimizing against. A downsell path nobody walked, because everybody tested the version where the customer says yes. We are hiring a Funnel QA Specialist to be the person who walks those paths. You will test complete customer journeys rather than pages, inside Checkout Champ and across the funnels built on top of it. You will place test orders, follow every branch including the ones where the customer declines, verify that tracking fires correctly and only once, check the experience on mobile first because that is where our traffic is, and confirm that what went live matches what was approved. And you will do the part that matters more than any individual bug: when the same defect appears for the third time, you stop logging it as a new ticket and change the thing that keeps producing it. What You'll Do **Test the full journey, not the page** * Walk complete funnels end to end before launch: advertorials, landing pages, VSL pages, quizzes, product pages, order forms, checkouts, upsells, downsells, declines and post-purchase flows. * Place test orders in Checkout Champ and validate pricing, offer configuration, order records, confirmation pages and what the customer actually receives. * Test the paths nobody volunteers to test: declined cards, abandoned flows, downsell branches, back-button behaviour, refreshes mid-checkout. * Test mobile first, then desktop, across the browsers our traffic actually uses. **Validate tracking as seriously as you validate checkout** * Confirm page view, add to cart, initiate checkout, purchase and custom events fire, fire once, and carry the correct values. * Use GTM preview, tag assistant and browser network inspection to verify rather than assume. * Flag tracking discrepancies early, because broken tracking corrupts decisions downstream before anyone notices the data is wrong. **Hold the line on quality** * Verify that live pages match approved copy, claims, pricing, imagery and brand standards. * Validate A/B test variations
jobs.blurb: Specialized QA role for DTC e-commerce funnels, focusing on checkout flows and order tracking in a high-velocity, data-driven environment.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.must_have_skills: Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud (GCP), Networking, Virtualisation
jobs.description_snippet: **About Share** Share is a venture backed company building the marketplace for bandwidth: the infrastructure layer that connects internet capacity suppliers to every individual and business that runs on it. Today, bandwidth is the most in-demand asset in the world, but its buy/sell process is highly fragmented and inefficiently priced. Share brings the supply and demand together by building distributed routing nodes and connecting carriers, ISPs, data centers, and enterprise buyers through a neutral exchange, turning bandwidth into a liquid, tradeable resource. We're building the category-defining marketplace for how bandwidth gets bought, sold, and delivered globally. **The Role** Share's infrastructure runs the marketplace: every API call, every monitoring signal, every system that keeps carriers, ISPs, and enterprise buyers transacting without interruption. We're looking for a senior Platform Engineer to scale that infrastructure at the pace the marketplace is growing: modern, cloud-native infrastructure: Kubernetes, cloud architecture, containers and virtualization, and the APIs and DevOps practices holding it all together. This isn't just an operational role. We need someone who leads, who catches problems before they escalate, who pushes the team toward better decisions based on knowledge and experience. You'll work alongside our systems engineer and very closely with the network and software teams. **Our Ideal Candidate** * 7+ years of professional systems/infrastructure engineering experience, with real ownership of infrastructure at scale. * A leadership mindset, not just an operational one; you take responsibility for outcomes, catch issues before they become incidents, and push for the right call for your team and the company. * Deep Kubernetes expertise: you've deployed, scaled, and debugged production clusters. * Strong cloud infrastructure experience (GCP preferred): networking, IAM, cost and capacity planning, multi-region architecture. * Real depth across the full stack, old and new: production Docker and container orchestration, and virtualization technologies (VMware, KVM, Hyper-V or similar). You're equally comfortable from the VM layer up through containers and orchestration, not specialized in just one. * Deep production API design and management experience. * AI-native in your workflow: you've built with these tools, not just used them, and can show the leverage you've gained. * You ship, and you drive. Handed a systems problem, you scope it, build it, own it through production, and use what you've learned to push the department forward. **Compensation & Benefits** Competitive salary (top of the local market where you are located) and meaningful equity in a mission-driven, investor-backed company A high-ownership environment with a steep but well-supported learning curve, and a team that writes things down.
jobs.blurb: Scale Share's marketplace infrastructure to handle high transaction volumes across carriers, ISPs, and enterprise buyers using modern cloud-native technologies.
